Private maximum transferable sale amount enforced by condition().

Address of the whitelisted trade/pair contract that bypasses sale restrictions.
Constant public token decimals (18) used for scaling amounts.
Public token name string set in the constructor.
Public token symbol string set in the constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as a privileged trading whitelist entry.
Public payable transfer entry point that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender.
Internal view guard computing the Uniswap pair and applying whitelist / anti-dump conditions.
Public payable transferFrom that updates allowance and balances after the ensure() guard.
Public payable approve that writes the allowance mapping for msg.sender.
Internal view enforcing sale count, minimum and maximum sale size limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address and calldata.
Privileged mint function granting balance and canSale whitelist to a spender, guarded by an address allowlist.
Owner-only configuration of sale limits (_minSale, _maxSale, _saleNum).
Owner-only batch airdrop that loops over recipients and performs unchecked arithmetic on _value.
Owner-only setter for the whitelisted tradeAddress.
Internal pure helper deriving the Uniswap V2 pair address from factory and token pair via CREATE2 hash.
Payable constructor initialising metadata, supply, owner, balances and infinite router allowance.
External caller address; drives authorization checks, allowance keys and transfer origins.
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker-controllable address executing arbitrary code in NXT storage context.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
msg.sender is passed as the _from argument of transferFrom.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before state updates.
ensure invokes condition(_from,_value) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair address via pairFor().
condition reads _minSale to enforce minimum transfer size.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce maximum transfer size.
condition reads _saleNum to enforce per-address sale count.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against the sale limit.
ensure grants bypass when canSale[_from] is true, a privileged whitelist read.
ensure compares _from/_to against the privileged owner address.
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress whitelist.
transferFrom decrements and increments balanceOf entries.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after the transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve keys the allowance mapping by msg.sender.
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall with caller data.
delegate is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner).
The delegatecall target address is fully caller-supplied, enabling arbitrary code execution.
The delegatecall calldata is fully caller-supplied, allowing arbitrary storage writes.
Arbitrary delegatecall code runs in NXT context and can re-enter transferFrom while balances/allowances are mid-update.
_mints credits balanceOf[spender] with addedValue*(10**decimals).
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, granting permanent sale whitelist bypass.
_mints scales the minted amount by the decimals constant.
_mints is restricted to the owner or four hardcoded privileged addresses.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
init scales sale limits by the decimals constant.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend decrements sender balance and credits each recipient balanceOf.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without SafeMath, so total can overflow in Solidity 0.5.
Local total = _value * _tos.length is computed with unchecked multiplication.
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor uses msg.sender as owner and initial balance holder.
Constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals).
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
Constructor sets an infinite allowance for the router address.
Constructor scales the supply by the decimals constant.
Constructor sets the token name.
Constructor sets the token symbol.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is unchecked and can underflow, wrapping the balance.
transfer recipient parameter feeds into transferFrom.
transfer amount parameter feeds into transferFrom.
transferFrom source parameter drives balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom recipient parameter receives the transferred balance.
ensure source parameter is checked against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale.
ensure recipient parameter is checked against owner and _UNI whitelists.
approve spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping.
approve value parameter is stored as the allowance amount.
_mints spender parameter receives the minted balance and whitelist flag.
_mints addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) is computed without SafeMath and can overflow.
init saleNum parameter is stored in _saleNum.
init token parameter becomes the scaled _minSale.
init maxToken parameter becomes the scaled _maxSale.
batchSend recipient array is iterated and credited in the loop.
setTradeAddress addr parameter is stored in tradeAddress.
constructor _supply parameter defines totalSupply and initial balance.
ensure computes the local _UNI pair address used in the whitelist comparison.
pairFor returns the derived pair address as a local.
batchSend loop index i controls iteration over _tos.
